name: David
bio: David is named at the very end of Ruth's genealogy (4:17, 22) as the great-grandson of Boaz and Ruth — the point toward which the whole book has quietly been building. Israel's most celebrated king, whose fuller story spans 1 and 2 Samuel, traces his ancestry back to a Moabite widow's loyalty and a kinsman-redeemer's faithfulness in this small book.
